title: The session cookie goes wherever it is asked
brief: A token check closes a forged request on one endpoint. The cookie's own settings can close it on all of them at once, by telling the browser not to attach the session to requests another site starts. Get it right without signing out every customer who clicks a link in their order email.

attackSuite.payload: An auto-submitting form on another site
attackSuite.label: Rides the session cross-site

attackSuite.payload: document.cookie read by an injected script
attackSuite.label: Steals the session outright

functionalSuite.value: Clicking 'view your order' in the confirmation email
functionalSuite.label: Arriving signed in

hints: Two settings are wrong here, and they protect against different attacks.
SameSite has three values. One is what we have, one is too strict for a shop, one is right.
